title: Informative tour of Gaudi's buildings
text: It was a wonderful walking tour of Gaudi's buildings, led by Dani.  He was fun, energetic, and full of information.  You will do a bit of urban walking.  I would totally recommend going.  I only wish that we would see at least the insides of one of the homes (and that this would be included in the cost of the tour).  We only saw the exterior of each building.

title: We did the walking tour...
text: We did the walking tour with Laszlo last weekend and it was great. He was so informative without being boring and really seemed to care about what he was telling us. I would highly recommend booking with him if you can.

title: Passionate and humorous tour
text: Dani was amazing and explained everything with such humour and passion. The tour was very informative and yet not boring at all! Learned some unusual facts about Gaudi and history of the buildings. Highly recommend :))
